scripts.build: npm run build -w @tetherchat/shared && npm run build -w @tetherchat/api && npm run build -w @tetherchat/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tetherchat/api" "npm run dev -w @tetherchat/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tetherchat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tetherchat/api && npm run typecheck -w @tetherchat/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @tetherchat/shared && npm run test -w @tetherchat/shared && npm run test -w @tetherchat/api && npm run test -w @tetherchat/web
